_comment.about: podman-watchdog configuration. Copy to /etc/podman-watchdog/config.json (mode 0600, root-owned). Webhook secrets are injected via env (DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL / TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL) so they never live in the repo. The real config.json is git-ignored.
_comment.fastTickSec: Detection cadence (s): fork-free reads of meminfo/pressure/per-container pids (+ per-container memory when memory.alertContainer is on) + risk evaluation. Calibrated: 5.
_comment.slowTickSec: Enrich cadence (s): podman ps id->name refresh, podman stats, OOM events, log prune. Calibrated: 30.
_comment.pidmax.critPct: Per-container ratio for CRIT. 0.90 => 1843/2048. Must be >= warnPct.
_comment.pidmax.rateProjectTicks: Rate-of-approach: warn early if, at the current per-tick delta, the container is projected to reach pids.max within this many fast ticks. Calibrated: 3.
_comment.pidmax.rateMinRatio: Rate-of-approach only applies once the ratio is at least this. Calibrated: 0.50. (pids.max === 'max' is always EXEMPT from all pidmax/rate alerting.)
_comment.pidmax.alertWarn: Emit the WARN (>=warnPct, below critPct) finding. Set false to alert only at >=critPct. Default true.
_comment.pidmax.alertRate: Emit the rate-of-approach finding. Default true.
_comment.memory.psiSomeAvg10CritPct: 'some avg10=' percent for CRIT. Calibrated: 30. Must be >= warn.
_comment.memory.memAvailWarnBytes: MemAvailable absolute backstop for WARN (bytes). Calibrated: ~12 GiB.
_comment.memory.memAvailCritBytes: MemAvailable absolute backstop for CRIT (bytes). Calibrated: ~5 GiB. Must be <= warn.
_comment.memory.ponrBufferBytes: Buffer added to the parsed earlyoom effective kill threshold to compute the 'point-of-no-return' CRIT line (bytes). Calibrated: 512 MiB.
_comment.memory.alertHost: Emit the host-level memory findings (PSI / MemAvailable / point-of-no-return). Default true.
_comment.memory.alertContainer: Emit a per-container memory WARN when one container's working set reaches containerHostWarnPct of host MemTotal. The shared containers have no per-container memory limit, so 'fraction of host' is the meaningful signal. Default false (opt-in).
_comment.memory.containerHostWarnPct: Per-container memory WARN threshold as a fraction of host MemTotal. 0.75 => a single container using >= 75% of host RAM.
_comment.cooldownSec: Per (entity, severity) debounce window (s). Escalation warn->crit fires immediately. Calibrated: 300.
_comment.resolveAfterClears: Consecutive clear evaluations before a key is forgotten (and, when sendResolve, a RESOLVE alert is emitted). Calibrated: 2.
_comment.sendResolve: Send a RESOLVE message when a condition clears. Set false to send alerts only (no recovery messages). Default true.
_comment.logRetentionHours: Delete metrics-YYYYMMDD.jsonl files older than this. Calibrated: 48.
_comment.notifier: Which sink alerts are delivered to: 'discord' or 'teams'.
_comment.discord.webhookUrl: Discord webhook URL. SECRET. Injected via DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL env; leave as REPLACE_ME here.
_comment.discord.retries: POST retry attempts after the first try. On total failure the full alert is logged to stderr (journald). Calibrated: 3.
_comment.discord.backoffMs: Exponential backoff base (ms): waits backoffMs * 2^attempt. Calibrated: 1000.
_comment.teams.webhookUrl: Microsoft Teams Power Automate 'Workflows' incoming webhook URL. SECRET. Injected via TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL env; leave empty here.
_comment.teams.retries: POST retry attempts after the first try. Calibrated: 3.
_comment.paths: Filesystem locations. cgroupRoot / memCgroupRoot are the cgroup v1 pids / memory parents for rootful podman. stateFile is 0644 world-readable (widget contract, no secrets). logDir holds daily JSONL.
